habitat: Outnumbers other swallows in summer and mixes with them and with swifts over most habitats. Flocks perch on roadside wires and roost in reed beds.
summary: An abundant summer visitor. Metallic blue above, with a chestnut forehead, chin and throat that looks all-dark at a distance, and white underparts. The tail is forked. Moulting birds in November to January often lack the chestnut chin and the long tail-shafts. Immatures, common from October to December, can have very pale throats. Flocks twitter when settled. The characteristic call is a soft wheet. Males add a short warble and a wheezy phrase. Months were left unset. The Kemp name is European Swallow and the code NB was left unchanged.

similar.note: White-throated Swallow is clean white below, with a black breast-band, not a chestnut throat.
House Martin has a white rump and a squarer tail. Barn Swallow has the chestnut throat.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^17=131072 mature individuals (non-breeding visitor); paper interval half–double → 65536–262144.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

head.pattern: Chestnut forehead, chin and throat. The colour line also calls the throat black. It looks all-dark at a distance.

tail.shape: Forked, with long tail-shafts except on many moulting birds.

head.pattern: Can show a very pale throat. Common from October to December.

viewNotes.note: Blue above, chestnut throat and white underparts, with a forked tail.
Chestnut chin and throat, looking dark at a distance, then white underparts.
Long tail-shafts, often missing on moulting birds from November to January.

calls.description: Flocks give a soft twitter when settled. The characteristic call is a soft wheet. Males add a short warble and a wheezy phrase, not given a separate file. Grade A call from Mar Chiquita, Argentina. The filename names Barn Swallow.
